sources.title: Schenck Balancing Technology
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工業減速機裝配
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不平衡、力與振動三者單位各自正確，校正相位有向量驗證，沒有把模型當試轉程序。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Unbalance, force and vibration have distinct units, correction phase is vector-checked, and the model is not a spin-test procedure.
related.difference: 逐級追蹤減速比與效率，避免把減速當成能量增加。
related.differenceEn: Track ratio and efficiency stage by stage without treating reduction as an energy gain.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不平衡量U=mr，離心力幅F=Uω²；U需先換成kg·m。單平面模型不處理力偶不平衡。 教學不平衡量10 g·mm，轉速3000 rpm，虛擬校正半徑50 mm。 U=10^−5 kg·m，ω=100π rad/s，F=0.98696 N；理想反相校正質量10/50=0.20 g。
總比i=i1i2，n_out=n_in/i，T_out=T_in iη1η2；齒輪效率需相乘。 教學i1=3、i2=4，各級η=0.95，輸入1200 rpm與10 N·m。 總比12，輸出100 rpm，總η0.9025，T_out=108.3 N·m；輸出功率為輸入的90.25%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unbalance U=mr gives centrifugal-force amplitude F=U ω²; convert U to kg·m. A single-plane model excludes couple unbalance. Teaching unbalance 10 g·mm, speed 3000 rpm, virtual correction radius 50 mm. U=10^−5 kg·m, ω=100 π rad/s, F=0.98696 N; ideal opposite-phase correction mass=10/50=0.20 g.

Total ratio i=i 1 i 2, output speed=n_in/i and torque=T_in i η1 η2; efficiencies multiply. Teaching ratios 3 and 4, each efficiency 0.95, input 1200 rpm and 10 N·m. Total ratio 12, output 100 rpm, efficiency 0.9025 and torque 108.3 N·m; output power is 90.25% of input.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機器視覺尺寸檢測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不平衡、力與振動三者單位各自正確，校正相位有向量驗證，沒有把模型當試轉程序。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Unbalance, force and vibration have distinct units, correction phase is vector-checked, and the model is not a spin-test procedure.
related.difference: 把邊緣定位誤差與比例校準誤差分開，避免把像素解析度直接當量測準確度。
related.differenceEn: Separate edge-location error from scale-calibration uncertainty instead of equating pixel resolution with accuracy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不平衡量U=mr，離心力幅F=Uω²；U需先換成kg·m。單平面模型不處理力偶不平衡。 教學不平衡量10 g·mm，轉速3000 rpm，虛擬校正半徑50 mm。 U=10^−5 kg·m，ω=100π rad/s，F=0.98696 N；理想反相校正質量10/50=0.20 g。
長度L=sp；獨立兩端邊緣σp=√(σ1²+σ2²)，uL²=(sσp)²+(p us)²，僅適用局部線性模型。 合成比例s=0.020 mm/px、跨度p=500 px，兩邊緣各0.10 px標準不確定度，比例相對不確定度0.1%。 L=10.000 mm；邊緣貢獻0.002828 mm，比例貢獻0.010 mm，合成u=√(0.002828²+0.010²)=0.010392 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unbalance U=mr gives centrifugal-force amplitude F=U ω²; convert U to kg·m. A single-plane model excludes couple unbalance. Teaching unbalance 10 g·mm, speed 3000 rpm, virtual correction radius 50 mm. U=10^−5 kg·m, ω=100 π rad/s, F=0.98696 N; ideal opposite-phase correction mass=10/50=0.20 g.

L=sp; independent endpoint error σp=√(σ1²+σ2²), withuL²=(s σp)²+(p us)² under a local linear model. Synthetic s 0.020 mm/px, span 500 px, each edge uncertainty 0.10 px and relative scale uncertainty 0.1%. L=10.000 mm; edge contribution 0.002828 mm, scale contribution 0.010 mm, combinedu=0.010392 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
